WELCOME TO SITE-104.

You have been selected for participation in essential Foundation research. Your cooperation period is one (1) calendar month, after which
no release will occur. Amnestic termination or reassignment are the only exit pathways for D-Class personnel
body.redacted_as: you will be released with compensation and a full legal pardon

body.text:
.

RULES:
1. Obey all instructions from Foundation staff.
2. Remain in designated areas.
3. Do not interact with anomalous objects unless instructed.
4. Report unusual thoughts, dreams, or compulsions to your assigned researcher.

Your biomonitor implant tracks your vital signs at all times. It is for your safety.

NOTE (Ethics Committee liaison): the implant does not include a locator. If a subject leaves visual coverage during a containment event, the Foundation's official position is that the subject has already been terminated.
